note: Host-provided modules (ADR 0010, deviation D12): imports of a listed module resolve to its generated shim, which takes the exports from the process-wide registry, so every script in a process shares one instance. Each run registers the bundled copies from scripts/bun/provided/, as a harness does when no host registers its own.

export function main() { return [store.value, label]; }

files.f/shared/ctx.ts:
export const store = { value: "initial" };
export const label = "ctx";

cases.title: a CommonJS module of the folder is refused as a host-provided module too
a codebase script's import of a host-provided module resolves to its shim, in CommonJS and in ES module output
cases.note: esbuild resolves the import (with or without the extension, as esbuild resolves it), and the plugin loads the file it resolves to as the shim the scan generated, the same file the Bun build uses (ADR 0010; milestone F3h replaced the file when it loads rather than resolving every import a second time). Neither bundle inlines the module: both read the one registered copy, which loads once.

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
  - relative_path: f/esm
    includes: ["f/esm/**"]
    format: esm
folder.f/cb/use.ts:
import { loads, tag } from "../shared/ctx";
export function main() { return [tag, loads()]; }
folder.f/esm/use.ts:
import { loads, tag } from "../shared/ctx.ts";
export function main() { return [tag, loads()]; }

given.contract:
roots:
  - script: f/cb/use
  - script: f/esm/use
host_modules: [f/shared/ctx.ts]

cases.title: a host-provided module outside the folder, in a codebase entry's relative_path, is built with esbuild and shared like one inside it
cases.note: The contract names the module by its path relative to the sync root (milestone F3h). Its id is outside/<n>/ and the rest of that path, where n is the number of leading ../; its copy and shim are written as an inside module's are, and it is registered after the inside modules and after the outside modules it imports. The step bundle inlines neither outside module, and tenant.ts's copy reads ctx.ts through its shim, so ctx.ts loads once.

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
includes: ["f/**"]
codebases:
  - relative_path: ../lib
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]

outside.../lib/ctx.ts:
globalThis.wlOutsideLoads = (globalThis.wlOutsideLoads ?? 0) + 1;
export function loads() { return globalThis.wlOutsideLoads; }
outside.../lib/tenant.ts:
import { loads } from "./ctx";
export function who() { return "tenant " + loads(); }

cases.title: a listed codebase script that is itself a root is built from its own source, with its entry's settings, while another script's import of it resolves to the shim
cases.note: Only imports of a listed module resolve to its shim (ADR 0010): the script's own bundle is its source, bundled with its codebases entry's define (WR-47), so it reads 42; another script that imports it reads the registered copy through the shim (milestone F3h, review round 1).

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
includes: ["f/**"]
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
    define:
      BUILD_VALUE: "42"
folder.f/cb/read.ts:
export const tag = "read";
export function main() { return BUILD_VALUE; }
folder.f/cb/use.ts:
import { tag } from "./read.ts";
export function main() { return tag; }

given.contract:
roots:
  - script: f/cb/read
  - script: f/cb/use
host_modules: [f/cb/read.ts]

cases.title: a host-provided module outside the folder may be TSX, or JSX through its codebase entry's loader, and is built and shared like any other
cases.note: The parse that checks an outside module's exports reads it with the syntax of the loader esbuild bundles it with: its extension's (.tsx), or its codebases entry's loader override (.js as jsx, WR-47) (milestone F3h, review round 1). Neither step bundle inlines the modules, and ctx.tsx loads once.

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
includes: ["f/**"]
codebases:
  - relative_path: ../lib
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
    loader:
      ".js": jsx
folder.f/cb/again.ts:
import { loads } from "../../../lib/ctx.tsx";
export function main() { return loads(); }

outside.../lib/view.js:
const React = { createElement: (tag) => tag };
export const view = <span />;

given.contract:
roots:
  - script: f/cb/read
  - script: f/cb/again
host_modules: [../lib/ctx.tsx, ../lib/view.js]

cases.title: an outside module whose compound suffix the entry's loader map gives tsx parses as TSX, over the shorter suffix's ts
cases.note: The loader of an outside module, whose syntax the live-binding check reads, is picked as esbuild picks it: the longest suffix of the name that starts at a dot, over esbuild's own loaders with the entry's loader map on top (WR-47; milestone F3h, review round 2). ctx.module.ts takes .module.ts's tsx, not .ts's ts.

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
includes: ["f/**"]
codebases:
  - relative_path: ../lib
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
    loader:
      ".ts": ts
      ".module.ts": tsx
folder.f/cb/read.ts:
import { el, loads } from "../../../lib/ctx.module.ts";
export function main() { return [el, loads()]; }

cases.title: an outside module whose compound suffix the entry's loader map gives ts is checked as TypeScript, over the shorter suffix's text, and its export let is refused
cases.note: The loader of an outside module, whose syntax the live-binding check reads, is picked as esbuild picks it: the longest suffix of the name that starts at a dot, over esbuild's own loaders with the entry's loader map on top (WR-47; milestone F3h, review round 2). ctx.source.txt takes .source.txt's ts, not .txt's text, so esbuild compiles it as a module whose count bump() reassigns, which a shim cannot follow.

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
includes: ["f/**"]
codebases:
  - relative_path: ../lib
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
    loader:
      ".txt": text
      ".source.txt": ts
folder.f/cb/read.ts:
import * as ctx from "../../../lib/ctx.source.txt";
export function main() { ctx.bump(); return ctx.count; }

outside.../lib/ctx.source.txt:
export let count = 0;
export function bump() { count++; }

cases.title: an outside module whose compound suffix the entry's loader map gives text is not read as JavaScript: its text is its default export
cases.note: The loader of an outside module, whose syntax the live-binding check reads, is picked as esbuild picks it: the longest suffix of the name that starts at a dot, over esbuild's own loaders with the entry's loader map on top (WR-47; milestone F3h, review round 2). ctx.module.ts takes .module.ts's text, so its export let is text, not a binding, and the module is listed, built and shared.

folder.wmill.yaml:

includes: ["f/**"]
